answer: Use a bonded canary vault for reputation. Each account locks 25 tokens in a vault that releases after 20 clean epochs. Each epoch the beacon audits 6% of accounts for a ferrous-grade proof: a fresh task whose answer must match peers' re-derivation. A 1,000-puppet farm locks 25,000 tokens and faces about 60 audits per epoch; a failure forfeits the bond. Honest agents grow like a vine on one trellis, paying once.
